name: AdService Feature Flag Failures
summary: AdService error rate exceeds 20% for 5 minutes
description: The adservice is experiencing an elevated error rate likely due to the adServiceFailure feature flag. This flag causes approximately 30% of requests to fail with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED gRPC errors (status code 8). The service logs warnings when failures occur with messages like 'adServiceFailure fail feature flag enabled, failing request' followed by 'GetAds Failed with status Status{code=RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, description=null, cause=null}'.

annotations.impact: Users may experience failed ad requests affecting revenue and user experience
